rule: Band LIFTED. Whole board, selected by tightest bid/ask, posted at mid rather than crossed. Goal is slow recovery, so cost is the lever.
seed: 20261010 (sha256 of seed|slug for the side, seed|g|game for the game order)
note: Third build of the day. The 07:30 version had 4 picks and no football on a Saturday; the 08:02 rebuild added 3 NCAAF but still ran card.py with its default --cap 0.53, so it was STILL enforcing the band Kiley removed -- which is why MLB showed 1 upcoming game and 0 candidates. This build uses picks/wide.py: whole board, 1556 markets at a 1c spread or tighter, 102 distinct games, 16 taken round-robin across leagues.

research.what_the_band_was_costing: The MLB Game 5 board quotes spread/total/winner at a 0.005 spread -- the tightest markets available all day -- and all eight sit outside 47-53% (0.217 to 0.738). The old band excluded the cheapest prices on the board by construction.
research.league_swamping: Sorting the whole board by tightness alone returned 16 of 16 NCAAF, because CFB has 94 games and ties at 0.005 break by seed. Fixed by round-robin. Checked the price clustering it produced (every mid 0.5625 or 0.6875) against a wider sample -- 86 distinct mids in 141 markets, so that was a selection artifact of the minimum-spread tier, not a data problem.
research.cost: Crossing costs $4.43 of EV per $100 at zero edge, resting at mid $3.48. If the fee is a taker fee as the published schedules say, a filled maker order pays zero and break-even at 50c drops to 49.69%. Unverified.
research.no_nfl: 0 upcoming NFL -- they play Sunday. WNBA and UCL list nothing.

claude.basis: tightest spread on the board -- no edge claimed
claude.rung_why: Selected by COST, not by price band. The 47-53% rule is lifted, and it was throwing out the cheapest markets on the board: the one MLB game quoted all eight of its markets at a 0.005 spread and not one was inside the old band. With no predictive edge the only lever measured to work is what it costs to get in, so this takes the tightest bid/ask available and POSTS at mid rather than crossing. Leagues are round-robined -- a global sort on tightness gave 16 of 16 NCAAF, which is no more 'the whole board' than the band was. Side by seeded toss, recorded, so nothing drifts to chalk.
